messages:
sam-platform: Heads-up — rolling a tighter egress FW in eu-west-1 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Plan is to deny 0.0.0.0/0 except explicit S3/KMS/privatelink endpoints. This is for audit/compliance. Concern: GPU warm-pool / onboarding impact.

maria-infra: Noted. Nodes bootstrap via NAT to reach keystore proxy + KMS. If NAT gets rate-limited we saw ~40–60s extra per node in staging. Warm pools could be slow to refill.

jonathan-sre: Seen this pattern before — NAT/KMS spikes cause autoscaler to stall because new nodes can't complete keystore decrypt. Recommend canary only (5 nodes per AZ) + short window.

elaine-security: @sam-platform thanks — two asks: (1) ensure KMS endpoints are whitelisted, (2) route audit logs to aggregator via privatelink where possible. Blocking egress could increase aggregator side requests.

sam-platform: Proposed rollout: 1) canary eu-west-1a (5 GPU nodes) for 2h 2) watch keystore.decrypt 99p latency, node ready time, and gpu-queue length 3) if any signal crosses threshold -> immediate rollback 4) enable keystore-proxy v2 fallback (privatelink) if stable.

maria-infra: Quick cost heads-up — privatelink endpoints add ~+$1.2k/mo in that region, but NAT egress savings are ~-$3.4k/mo (est). I'll put a short cost table in the PR.

jonathan-sre: Also we need an alert: keystore.decrypt_errors > 1% for 10m -> rollback. And a spike in NAT 5xxs. I'll add to SLOs.

sam-platform: Terraform snippet (pseudo) to whitelist KMS/privatelink in SGs: ```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "allow_kms" {
  type        = "egress"
  from_port   = 443
  to_port     = 443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.0.0.0/16"]
}
```

elaine-security: Also need to confirm node IAM/key policy: nodes must have kms:Decrypt on regional CMKs and key policy must allow service account used by keystore-proxy. @maria-infra can you validate?

maria-infra: Confirming — key policy currently allows our node role but cross-account principals need explicit allow. I'll open a PR to annotate the key and add the privatelink principal where needed.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: eu-west-1 canary starts 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z — job id canary-evw-20260322-03

sam-platform: TL;DR — rolling egress tighten in eu-west-1, canary + metrics, fallback via privatelink/keystore-proxy v2, cost tradeoffs called out. Any blockers? :eyes:

jonathan-sre: No blockers from SRE side. Recommend 2h canary then gradual AZ-by-AZ. Rollback window 30m after first failure.

elaine-security: Approved from security after key policy PR lands.

maria-infra: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4821 — includes cost delta and key-policy change.

sam-platform: Thanks — I'll post the runbook and add dashboard panels (keystore decrypt, node-ready latency, nat 5xx rate). Ping if anything else.
